newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down for fourth day running.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down for fourth day running.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in low turnover for the fourth session running as investors eyed the public offer of copper firm KGHM Polska Miedz starting on Monday.
Analysts termed a longer-term threat a central banker's warning on Tuesday that Poland faced a Czech-style financial crisis in 1998 due to its increasing current account deficit.
On Wednesday the finance minister said foreign direct investment, monetary tightening and a leaner 1998 budget should avert a crisis.
